statements.status_notes: joi 18.2.9 contains the fix for CVE-2026-90771, but yarn/bump resolutions that move the OpenSearch Dashboards core tree to 18.2.9 fail with an invariant violation during lockfile resolution. The bundled copy remains at 18.2.8 until upstream adjusts the dependency tree or yarn resolutions can be applied safely.
